title: The chart pulls Kyverno's images from `reg.kyverno.io` instead of `ghcr.io`

detection.reason: registry mirrors, pull-through caches, egress rules and image allow-lists live outside the collected objects

remediation: From Kyverno 1.14.0 (chart 3.4.0) the admission, background, cleanup and reports controllers, the init container and the kyverno-cli hook image default to `reg.kyverno.io/kyverno/...` (values.yaml `image.defaultRegistry`; 1.13.3 made the same switch and 1.13.4 reverted it). Before upgrading, allow or mirror `reg.kyverno.io` wherever registries are restricted — egress firewall, containerd mirror, an image allow-list policy (including your own Kyverno policies) — or keep the old source by setting `image.registry: ghcr.io` on each component. An admission controller that cannot pull its image leaves the Kyverno webhooks unanswered.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.spec.template.spec.containers[]; .image | test("(^|/)kyverno/(kyverno|background-controller|cleanup-controller|reports-controller)([:@]|$)"))) | .metadata.namespace as $ns | (.spec.template.spec.containers[], .spec.template.spec.initContainers[]?) | "\($ns) \(.name) \(.image)"'  # each row is an image a Kyverno controller runs today; ghcr.io rows move to reg.kyverno.io unless image.registry is set

title: The chart's hook-Job images change — air-gapped mirrors need the image of the target version

detection.reason: registry mirrors live outside the cluster

remediation: The chart's Helm hook Jobs pull helper images that changed three times. The webhooks-cleanup image (`webhooksCleanup.image`, used by the pre-delete hooks) is `bitnami/kubectl` up to 1.14.4 and again on 1.15.0 (cut before the 1.14.5 backport), `alpine/kubectl` on 1.14.5, `registry.k8s.io/kubectl` from 1.15.1 and `ghcr.io/kyverno/readiness-checker` from 1.18.0; the post-upgrade report-cleanup hook (`policyReportsCleanup.image`) is `alpine/kubectl` on 1.14.5 and is gone from 1.15.1. Hooks run with the TARGET chart's values, so before an air-gapped upgrade mirror the image your target version uses (or pin your own with those values). On 1.14.4 or older the hooks still name `bitnami/kubectl` tags that are no longer published: the pre-delete hooks stall in ImagePullBackOff and `helm uninstall` hangs unless the image is overridden (seen with 1.13.6 on rtz-box) — and an upgrade TO 1.14.4 or 1.15.0 runs a post-upgrade hook with them.
verifyCommand: helm list -A -o json | jq -r '.[] | select(.chart | test("^kyverno-[0-9]")) | "\(.namespace)/\(.name) \(.chart) app \(.app_version)"'  # each row is a Kyverno Helm release; read its values with: helm get values NAME -n NAMESPACE
